purpose: Diagnostic upper benchmark only, frozen before historical clustering assignments and answer-key scoring.
method: Same v47 add-one multinomial naive Bayes using only six surface-context features. Train gold labels supply roles. Equal role priors, train vocabulary only; no tuning. Scores the same heldout roles and blocks, every panel retained. Compare fixed2 and null results to help distinguish missing context information from unsuitable unsupervised clustering. This supervised arm does not qualify blind discovery or replace a failed primary gate.
